html_description:
Bound by Blood and Harbor Light

THE PATRIARCH DOESN'T ASK. HE DRAWS THE CONTRACT. Elena Voss has counted every lock in the warded room and every clause in the marriage pact the Obsidian Coven wants signed by dawn. Julian Kane — Shadow Hand, steel eyes — is not here to negotiate.

Elena Voss has counted every lock in the warded room, every clause in the marriage pact, and every second Julian Kane has spent standing still at the far wall. Shadow Hand of the Obsidian Coven. Twelve years without a public failure. Steel eyes that assess before they speak.

The document on the table wants her signature. Her harbor districts. Her family's debts absorbed into Coven administration — and an initiation no one will describe until the morning it happens.

Julian Kane is not here to negotiate. Elena is not here to surrender. In mist-shrouded Harbor Light, loyalty is currency and love has no category in the ledger.

What you will find inside

  • Dark mafia romance — Coven protocol, marriage pact, initiation cost
  • Slow-burn heat — steel eyes, ward-stone safehouse, earned trust
  • Forced proximity — one locked room, one blank signature line
  • Harbor Light Book 1 — start the series here
  • HEA with a price — devotion that refuses to be holy

If you crave dark mafia romance where love costs something real — start reading tonight.

Scroll up and grab your copy.
